brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is '18oz waxed cotton duck / leather'. This is correct for the three 'Originals' line bags (Nelson Longflap, Barley, Camper Longflap): the maker's own spec page for each states 'Material: 18 oz Waxed Cotton Duck' verbatim, and all three photos show the classic mottled, slightly glossy waxed-canvas surface with cream leather billet straps and nickel buckles - unmistakably traditional saddlebag construction, nothing like the rest of this catalogue. FLAGGED DISCREPANCY on the two 'Super C' line products (SQR Slim, Rear Panniers): the maker's own copy for both ALSO states 'Made from 18-ounce cotton duck' / '18 oz Waxed Cotton Duck', but the photos of both show a smooth, matte, technical-looking black fabric with a fine synthetic weave and black PLASTIC side-release buckles - no wax sheen, no leather anywhere, nothing like the visibly waxed canvas + leather of the Originals bags in this same brand's own photos taken under similar lighting. Carradice markets 'Super C' explicitly as a separate, more technical range from 'Originals', which makes reused/generic cotton-duck copy plausible. Recorded as verified:false / confidence:medium on the fabric field for these two products rather than silently trusting the page.
brand_notes.method: carradice.co.uk (Shopify) returns 0 bytes to a bare curl (User-Agent blocked); adding a standard browser User-Agent string returns full HTML with a 'Dimensions (WxHxD): ...' line and 'Material: ...' line present verbatim on every product page checked, independently confirming the WebFetch reads. All five dims below are maker-published, axis-labelled figures, not estimates.

products.name: Nelson Longflap Saddlebag
products.dims_note: CORRECTED from brands.json, which had this scrambled (len:19, hgt:22, wid:36 - none of which match the page's own W/H/D order). Verified independently via curl with a browser User-Agent (raw HTML confirms the string verbatim) against WebFetch, both agree. The page's own label is explicit: W=22 (across the bike -> wid), H=19 (top-to-bottom -> hgt), D=36, extending to 44cm with the longflap fully out (fore-aft depth, the bag's own long axis -> len). Per the new rule len takes the UNFURLED/extended figure (44), not the unextended 36 - this also matches capacity: 18L requires the flap extended, per the maker's own note that 36cm alone is the unextended state.

geometry.notes: Traditional rounded barrel-shaped canvas body, flat mounting face against the saddle rails/support, front flap (the 'longflap') folds down over the front face and buckles; extending the flap out is what adds the extra 8cm of length and the extra volume. Small external slip pocket on the front face with its own leather billet strap and buckle.

closure.hardware: single leather billet strap through a nickel buckle at the flap centre; longflap extension is the same strap let out further

details.seams: sewn, waxed canvas (traditional construction, not welded)
details.fabric: 18oz waxed cotton duck / leather trim - matches brands.json; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Hangs from two leather straps through saddle bag-loops (visible chrome D-ring at the mount point in the photo) and rests on a metal saddlebag support rack under the body - the support is a separate accessory, visible in the evidence photo, not modelled as part of this bag. Traditional saddle-rail hanging bag, not a seatpost-clamped design.

products.name: Barley Saddlebag
products.dims_note: CORRECTED from brands.json, which had wid and len swapped relative to the page's own W/H/D label (stored len:15, wid:29 - the reverse of the page). Verified independently via curl with a browser User-Agent, matches WebFetch. W=18 (across the bike -> wid), H=15 (top-to-bottom -> hgt), D=29 (fore-aft, the bag's own long axis -> len). No range given, single figure used directly. 18x15x29 = 7.8L box against the stated 9L, consistent with a canvas flap bag that over-stuffs slightly past its rated size.

geometry.notes: Smaller, squarer version of the Nelson without the longflap extension. Rounded canvas body, flat mounting face, front flap buckles down over the body. On-bike photo shows twin parallel strap channels dividing the flap visually into two lobes; this is the flap's strap routing, not two separate compartments.

closure.hardware: two leather billet straps through nickel buckles

details.seams: sewn, waxed canvas (traditional construction, not welded)
details.fabric: 18oz waxed cotton duck / leather trim - matches brands.json; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Hangs from two leather straps through saddle bag-loops, no support rack visible in this photo (small enough to self-support). Traditional saddle-rail hanging bag.

products.name: Camper Longflap Saddlebag
products.dims_note: Confirmed correct as already stored, independently re-verified via curl with a browser User-Agent (matches WebFetch). Page labels the axes explicitly: W=36 (across the bike -> wid), H=26 (top-to-bottom -> hgt), D=22 (fore-aft -> len). Unlike Nelson, no bracketed extended figure is published for the longflap here, so the single D figure is used as-is; 36x26x22 = 20.6L box against the stated 24L, the balance plausibly coming from the flap being let out beyond its resting 22cm depth in practice (not separately quoted).

geometry.notes: Largest of the three Originals saddlebags; wider (36cm across) than it is tall, rounded canvas body, front flap buckles down. Side lash loops visible for extra strapping.

closure.hardware: leather billet strap(s) through nickel buckle(s), longflap extends the covered depth

details.seams: sewn, waxed canvas (traditional construction, not welded)
details.fabric: 18oz waxed cotton duck / leather trim - matches brands.json; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Largest and heaviest of the three - photo shows it resting on a rear rack for support, similar to the Nelson. At 24L this needs a support rack or rear rack under it in practice; the rack itself is a separate accessory, not modelled.

products.name: Super C SQR Slim
evidence: https://carradice.co.uk/cdn/shop/products/carradice_scsqrslim-2.jpg (maker studio shot of the frame-side mounting face, fetched directly)
products.dims_note: AXIS-FUMBLE CHECK, run per the team's known SQR history: brands.json already stored this correctly (len:15, hgt:36, wid:29, i.e. NOT wid==len) and I re-verified it from scratch rather than trust that note. Fetched the maker's own studio photo of the bag's frame-side mounting face directly (carradice.co.uk/cdn/shop/products/carradice_scsqrslim-2.jpg): that face is visibly taller than it is wide, close to a 0.8:1 width:height ratio, matching W=29/H=36=0.81 - so W maps to wid (across the bike) and H maps to hgt (top-to-bottom) directly as labelled. D=15 is the shallow fore-aft depth, matching the 'Slim' name (kept thin front-to-back to clear the rider's heels off an SQR block) -> len. The on-bike customer photo (evidence 1) is from an ambiguous 3/4 angle and was NOT used to make this call, only to check hardware/mount details. 29x36x15 = 15.7L box against the stated 16L - a squat, boxy shape, not a tapered wedge.

geometry.notes: Modern technical version of a traditional saddlebag shape: a compact rounded box hanging off a quick-release seatpost block rather than saddle-loop straps. Frame-side face is a tall rounded rectangle with two vertical mounting straps and a top carry handle (per the maker studio photo); the opposite (outer) face carries the reflective 'Super C' branded patch and a horizontal compression strap (visible in the on-bike photo).

closure.hardware: single plastic side-release buckle at the top-front edge

details.reflective: triangular reflective patch below the 'Super C' branded badge
details.seams: self-sealing (maker copy), welded-look finish - see brand_notes.fabric for the material discrepancy
details.fabric: maker states 18oz waxed cotton duck; photos show a smooth matte technical fabric with plastic hardware, not visibly waxed canvas - flagged, see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Mounts via Carradice's SQR quick-release block clamped to the seatpost, not saddle-rail straps like the Originals bags - the block itself is a separate accessory (not modelled). Body hangs close and shallow behind the seatpost, its 'Slim' depth keeping it clear of the rider's heels.

products.name: Super C Rear Panniers
products.dims_note: Confirmed correct as already stored, independently re-verified via curl with a browser User-Agent (matches WebFetch). For a pannier the maker's 'W' conventionally names the long flat panel that runs fore-aft along the rack (-> our len), not the across-bike protrusion, and 'D' names how far it sticks out sideways from the rack (-> our wid); this reading matches the on-bike photo, where the pannier body is clearly longer front-to-back than it is thick side-to-side, and is by far the tallest dimension of the three. Stored litres (27L) is per pannier; 54L is the pair.

geometry.notes: Boxy pannier, flat rack-facing back panel, front-facing flap pocket with its own buckle closure (visible on the front-most pannier in the photo, below the 'Super C' patch), reflective circular patch on the lower side face.

closure.hardware: single plastic side-release buckle at the top flap

details.seams: self-sealing (maker copy) - see brand_notes.fabric for the material discrepancy
details.fabric: maker states 18oz waxed cotton duck; photos show a smooth matte technical fabric with plastic hardware, not visibly waxed canvas - flagged, see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Standard rack-hook pannier, no rail or seatpost mounting; requires a rear rack.
